answer: The graph explorer draws from the `relation` index (`Tag/relation`). That index was introduced in commit 91349448 on 2026-05-21, which added the `relation` indexer and demoted `link` to a virtual view. The CHANGELOG lists it under 2.9.0.

Every meaningful element — [[Tag/page|pages]], headers, [[Tag/task|tasks]], list items, [[Tag|tags]], links — becomes an **[[Object|object]]** (a “row”) with attributes, typed by one or more tags (“tables”), queried via [[Space Lua/Integrated Query]] and the [[API/index]] API. / Two principles hold it together: / * **Markdown is the source of truth.** Every indexed object has a representation in the markdown.   - The interactive object-graph explorer visualizes objects such as pages, items and blocks, and the typed relations between them.

  The Object Index stores [[Object|Objects]] found in your [[Space]]. / The [[Page Picker]], [[Meta Picker]] and [[Linked Mention|Linked Mentions]] use this index. Explore its records in [[Workbench/Data]], or read them through [[API/index]].
  - index.objects(tag) is an entry point of the Object Index, for example index.objects("page").
[6] Reference/Indexing Internals.md (Indexing process)
